title: Nutty Crispy Uruguayan Chicken Skewers
description: Indulge in the rich flavors of Uruguay with these crispy chicken skewers, marinated in a mixture of Massaman curry paste and nuts, then poached to perfection. This keto-friendly dish is perfect for a special occasion.
instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine Massaman curry paste, chopped almonds, chopped walnuts, coconut oil, lime juice, salt, and black pepper. Blend until smooth.
Thread the chicken pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the curry paste mixture evenly onto the chicken pieces.
Poach the chicken skewers in boiling water for 10-12 minutes, or until cooked through.
Remove the skewers from the water and place them on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the skewers in the preheated oven for 10-12 minutes, or until crispy and golden brown.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve immediately.
